description: Read-only: the ids a style offers, by category (characters, objects, places, cameras, actions, emotions, text_presets, text_animations, transitions and outro moves, lights, looks, elements, samples), with names and short notes. With no category and no search it returns counts only; pass category and/or search to keep answers small. Every id you pass to set_cast, direct_cast, set_text, set_camera, set_light, set_place or set_transition must come from here. For ready-made shot recipes to add, use samples.

category.description: One of: characters, objects, places, cameras, actions, emotions, text_presets, text_animations, transitions, lights, looks, elements, samples.

search.description: Words to look for in id, name, group and note, like 'zoom' or 'sad'.

style.description: A style id from list_styles. Default: the project's style.

name: library
